title: Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are:

Girl Effect builds media and tech that adolescent girls in Africa and Asia want, trust, and need. Reaching over 50 million girls, the organization provides safe spaces to access crucial facts about health, education, and relationships, empowering them to redefine what is possible. We operate three chatbots in India, South Africa and Kenya which have reached nearly 3 million users, providing answers at scale to the most pressing questions related to sex health, mental wellbeing and livelihoods, whilst directing users to real world services. In the next 5 years, we intend to scale even further. By 2030, we believe we can reach 30 million girls through our chatbot solutions, providing highly personalised experiences augmented by Artificial Intelligence.

The Tech & Evolution

  • The Shift to GenAI: For over a decade, Girl Effect has leveraged user insights to build safer digital platforms.  The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has fundamentally transformed their product offerings.
  • Current Scale: Our custom GenAI feature—which safely sits behind strict, custom guardrails—has already processed over 150,000 user submissions. Plans are underway to expand this feature to mixed-coded languages in South Africa, Kenya, and India.
  • The Next Frontier: Girl Effect is moving from simple question-answering to creating complex, long-term conversational pathways such as Single Session Interventions (SSIs) for mental wellbeing. Our interactions are deeply rooted in behavioral science, designed to safely nudge vulnerable young users toward positive health outcomes.

To find out more about our approach and work to date, read our Whitepaper and AI Ethical Guidelines

The Technical Stack

  • AI & Orchestration: Python-based services integrating GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and Claude (Anthropic).
  • Infrastructure: Custom RAG pipeline, real-time performance metrics, and guardrails hosted on Azure.
  • Channels: We deploy to WhatsApp, MoyaApp, Telegram, and custom web apps.

Key Skills & Requirements

  • You’re a GenAI and LLM expert: You have hands-on, proven experience building with modern AI frameworks and models, using the elements described above in our technical stack. You possess a postgraduate degree in Data Science (or a similar field), are familiar with the full software development lifecycle, and can help to guide big architectural choices.
  • You care deeply about user safety: Working with vulnerable youth means safety isnt an afterthought for you. You are passionate about building responsible AI, setting up rigorous evaluation metrics, and ensuring every chatbot interaction is accurate, secure, and helpful.
  • You are an excellent collaborator and translator: You can seamlessly sit at the center of technical and non-technical worlds. You are comfortable talking code and setting standards with data scientists, whilst open to discussing impact and behavior change goals with subject matter experts in mental health, safeguarding, and evaluation to understand the use case.
  • You can juggle and own: You have strong organizational skills and are able to prioritize a technical roadmap in an agile environment. You are ready to conduct code reviews, design experiments to prove the tech works, and represent the organizations data science vision at public events or partner meetings.
  • You are mission-driven: Above all, you have a genuine passion for using technology to make a tangible, positive impact on the lives of young girls around the world.

Qualifications:

  • Postgraduate degree in Data Science or a relevant discipline
  • Strong technical acumen, able to guide decisions on digital platforms and tools.
  • Understanding and experience of the software lifecycle
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Proven expertise in the application of LLM and GenAI technologies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with staff at all levels of the organization
  • A genuine passion for our mission and the positive impact we’re making on the lives of girls.

What Else You Should Know

As we continue to scale and grow - we are hugely ambitious for our future and we are looking for people who are driven to change the world for girls. Our teams are a diverse mix across sectors (non-profit and commercial) and specialisms (from Creative through to Gender and Insight). You’ll learn and grow in an environment that will challenge you to think and work with a fresh perspective. In turn, you can expect to work somewhere where you will be stretched and developed in your role, a place where you can build your career and work with talented, engaged people committed to our cause. 

Girl Effect is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, or gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We are committed to building an organisation that is increasingly representative of the communities that we serve. To this end, due regard will be paid to recruiting candidates with diverse professional, academic and cultural backgrounds.

Furthermore, Girl Effect is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare and rights of all individuals, particularly the adolescent girls and young women we support. We have  zero-tolerance for safeguarding violations, including sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (SEAH). All employees are required to adhere to our safeguarding policies and successfully complete relevant background checks, including reference and criminal record checks where applicable.

How We Use Your Data & AI Assisting Tools: By applying, you agree that we may process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To help our team review applications efficiently, we use secure AI tools (including Google Workspace Gemini) to summarise and analyse CVs against job criteria.This process is strictly assistive; all final shortlisting and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. Your data is never used to train public AI models, is kept strictly confidential within our secure systems, and is processed in accordance with our full  Data Privacy Policy and the GDPR.

Application closing date: 29th June 2026
